route_summary: A Node.js Lambda helper that runs an asynchronous SQS batch handler through the actual Powertools BatchProcessor and returns its partial failure response. Protected preview executes the real processor on synthetic records only.
supported_boundary: A Node.js Lambda helper that runs an asynchronous SQS batch handler through the actual Powertools BatchProcessor and returns its partial failure response. Protected preview executes the real processor on synthetic records only. Protected preview executes the purchased handler module on synthetic records only; it does not invoke Lambda, SQS, or AWS.
